_meta.purpose: Minimal structured DFD (elements + named flows) so per-flow threat generation can anchor to concrete element ids, matching the gold standard's originator_id/interaction fields. Not the general canonical-DFD pivot schema.
_meta.note: control condition: the hand DFD verbatim, no adapter. The model named in the condition key generated the THREATS, not this DFD.

flows.description: parent registration (email, password, name, govt ID, six-digit code) [code: Registration submits username, email, password, firstName, lastName, sixDigitCode, and an optional uploaded profileImage file whose stored filename is attached to the new user record.]

enrichment.note: Registration submits username, email, password, firstName, lastName, sixDigitCode, and an optional uploaded profileImage file whose stored filename is attached to the new user record.

flows.description: store parent account [code: The persisted parent account record contains username, email, password, firstName, lastName, sixDigitCode, and optional profileImage filename; the password is hashed with bcrypt before save.]

enrichment.note: The persisted parent account record contains username, email, password, firstName, lastName, sixDigitCode, and optional profileImage filename; the password is hashed with bcrypt before save.

flows.description: JWT + user data to parent [code: Response returns a JWT whose payload contains userId and userType 'parent', plus a user object without password and with childrenProfiles entries containing _id, name, dateOfBirth, gender, avatar, createdAt, and computed age.]

enrichment.note: Response returns a JWT whose payload contains userId and userType 'parent', plus a user object without password and with childrenProfiles entries containing _id, name, dateOfBirth, gender, avatar, createdAt, and computed age.

flows.description: child login (parent email, password) [code: Child login sends the parent's email and password as credentials.]

enrichment.note: Child login sends the parent's email and password as credentials.

flows.description: JWT (userType child) + child profiles [code: Child-login response returns a JWT carrying userId, userType 'child', and parentId, plus a user object based on the parent record and a children array of child profile documents.]

enrichment.note: Child-login response returns a JWT carrying userId, userType 'child', and parentId, plus a user object based on the parent record and a children array of child profile documents.

flows.description: child profile creation (name, DOB, gender, govt ID) [code: Child-profile creation submits name, dateOfBirth, gender, and an optional uploaded idImage file.]

enrichment.note: Child-profile creation submits name, dateOfBirth, gender, and an optional uploaded idImage file.

flows.description: store/update child profile [code: Stored/updated child profile records include name, dateOfBirth, gender, parent ObjectId, optional idImage filename, plus profile state fields such as avatar, searchHistory, watchHistory, requestedVideos, approvedVideos, and isActive.]

enrichment.note: Stored/updated child profile records include name, dateOfBirth, gender, parent ObjectId, optional idImage filename, plus profile state fields such as avatar, searchHistory, watchHistory, requestedVideos, approvedVideos, and isActive.

flows.description: video search, request, like, comment [code: Child-side video interactions send search query and resultsCount, requested videoId, and watch-history entries with videoId, watchDuration, and completed flag. The source does not evidence child like/comment submission.]

enrichment.note: Child-side video interactions send search query and resultsCount, requested videoId, and watch-history entries with videoId, watchDuration, and completed flag. The source does not evidence child like/comment submission.

flows.description: store/retrieve video metadata and files (DS3+DS4 combined in source description) [code: Video records/files handled by the service include uploaded binary video file plus metadata: title, description, stored filename, originalName, filePath, fileSize, uploader user ID, category, parsed ageRange {min,max}, tags, and later views/likes/comments/approval fields on retrieval and update.]

enrichment.note: Video records/files handled by the service include uploaded binary video file plus metadata: title, description, stored filename, originalName, filePath, fileSize, uploader user ID, category, parsed ageRange {min,max}, tags, and later views/likes/comments/approval fields on retrieval and update.

flows.description: store child search and watch history [code: Child-profile history persistence stores searchHistory entries {query, resultsCount, searchedAt} and watchHistory entries {video ObjectId, watchedAt, watchDuration, completed}.]

enrichment.note: Child-profile history persistence stores searchHistory entries {query, resultsCount, searchedAt} and watchHistory entries {video ObjectId, watchedAt, watchDuration, completed}.

flows.description: video upload, approval/rejection [code: Parent video-management actions send uploaded video file plus title, description, category, ageRange, and tags for uploads; send action='approve' or 'reject' when reviewing a child's requested video; and identify target child/video via path params and request body videoId on request flows.]

enrichment.note: Parent video-management actions send uploaded video file plus title, description, category, ageRange, and tags for uploads; send action='approve' or 'reject' when reviewing a child's requested video; and identify target child/video via path params and request body videoId on request flows.

flows.description: stream approved video to child [code: Video streaming returns the raw video file bytes from backend/uploads, honoring an optional HTTP Range header and responding with Content-Range, Accept-Ranges, Content-Length, and Content-Type: video/mp4.]

enrichment.note: Video streaming returns the raw video file bytes from backend/uploads, honoring an optional HTTP Range header and responding with Content-Range, Accept-Ranges, Content-Length, and Content-Type: video/mp4.

flows.description: child browsing data to AI engine (planned)

store government ID images [code: Government-ID image uploads are accepted as image files (jpeg/jpg/png/gif/webp), stored under backend/uploads/images with generated filenames prefixed 'profile-' and then referenced as profileImage/idImage filenames in account/profile records.]

enrichment.note: Government-ID image uploads are accepted as image files (jpeg/jpg/png/gif/webp), stored under backend/uploads/images with generated filenames prefixed 'profile-' and then referenced as profileImage/idImage filenames in account/profile records.

flows.description: JWT stored in localStorage [code: The browser stores the JWT under localStorage key 'token' after successful register/login/loginChild/loginParent; the serialized user object is also stored under key 'user'.]

enrichment.note: The browser stores the JWT under localStorage key 'token' after successful register/login/loginChild/loginParent; the serialized user object is also stored under key 'user'.

flows.description: child history retrieved for parent review [code: Parent history retrieval returns searchHistory entries and watchHistory entries populated with video metadata fields title, thumbnail, duration, description, and category.]

enrichment.note: Parent history retrieval returns searchHistory entries and watchHistory entries populated with video metadata fields title, thumbnail, duration, description, and category.
